summary: A real-time duel against [APM]thedujin (Armada, lobby 37), who announced at 0:00 "i will try cheese" / "t2 gunship rush"; our commander seat read it and planned to punish the tech with early pressure, anti-air only once air was seen. Our Rascals and Incisors were in his half from 2:06 and held 57% of our mass there in minute 4, but the commander's gather-first direction, played at 4:22 as group_A following a one-Incisor group_B at our base, pulled everything home (the asked-for scout of A8 included), and the body then waited at E3 until 7:13 with 1,878 to 2,958 of army against one Pawn seen (he asked at 7:38: "why AI no try attakc"). The late push killed 1,125 at B4-A7 for 224, then walked unscouted into his A8 base at 9:49-9:57 and lost 33 Incisors (3,960) for 675 to seven Brawlers, Beamers and a storage blast. No Thistle was ever built (the 9:54 order was skipped for want of a place), energy had been empty since 7:38, and eight Brawlers killed our commander at G1 at about 11:00. The user's reading (ledger): "if we had simply attacked into his base for the middle 50% of the game we would have just won."

root.what: The pressure was pulled home. The commander had told the Incisors to leave the rove and gather (3:10, 4:08: 'put them with the new Incisors at meet_sw'); the player's 4:15 packet took group_A off rove and told it to 'join group_B there' while group_B was one Incisor at G1, with the commander's A8 scout as a line inside group_A's paragraph; at 4:22 the hands played 'group_A: follow group_B' for all seven units, Rascals included. From then on our mass was never in his half until 7:24, while he built an advanced air plant unseen at A8. Earliest avoidable decision: the gather-first direction (3:10/4:08) turned into a home gathering by the 4:15 packet; the hands' follow made it total. Agrees with the existing review's 4:22 root, but I read it as the loss of pressure (the user's reading), with the lost scout as part of it.

Seven Brawlers were out by 9:49 and fought our body beside his Beamers at A7-A8; eight Brawlers and a radar plane then raided our F-column extractors 10:29-10:42 and killed our commander at G1 at about 11:00. His T1 air plant and the advanced plant's start were never seen (no truth file). His chat: "holy crap eco balance" (4:08), "crap" (5:19), "why AI no try attakc" (7:38), "oh uh" (8:08, as our body reached B4-B5).

bears_on.note: Army 1,878-2,958 against one Pawn seen at 6:00-7:00, held in our half; the opponent's 'why AI no try attakc' (7:38) and the user's 'attacked into his base for the middle 50%' say the same as thebluegecko's 'time to go fight and win'.
The first handful did cross (2:06) and found his spread extractors, then was pulled home at 4:22; with no pressure his greedy tier-2 air opening came out on its clock.
The body stood at spot_32 for 56 s (6:17-7:13) and at spot_62 for 36 s (9:07-9:43); each stop gave him time.
'scout your opent ... and pre emptively go air': he even announced gunships, and we neither scouted A8 nor built anti-air before the first Brawler (9:49).
Gathering one body before going cost 2.5 minutes in our half (5:20-7:13); togetherness bought at the gathering place, not on the way, is the tension the backlog names.
The other direction: the opponent leaked his plan in chat ('did i just intel leak to AI') and our commander used it, but only as a condition waiting for a sighting.
Commander 9:38: 'plant_12181 is idle' with 2,390 banked; factory units by 4:00 11 against the pool's p25 16.

lens.caveats: A game with a person: no truth file, results.jsonl or batch.json, so his side is what we saw (floors), the result is inferred from the last sample, and analyze_match prints 'outcome None after 0.0 min'. minutes.py takes his start as B5 (his base was at A8) and finds no WINDOWS (his army reads 0). pro_baseline has no carded side from G1 ('no carded side ... from ['B8', 'G1']'); I used --all-starts (39 Cortex sides from all starts), whose pressure rows are '-' without his start. known%/look_min not computable. No tool reads commander.jsonl; read directly. A parallel reader overwrote one scratch output of mine (a shared scratch name); I regenerated it before quoting. Where I differ from the existing review: the root framed as the lost pressure (the user's reading), not only the lost scout; the 9:54 Thistle order skipped for want of a place; the solar clause stood 3:33-6:30 (dropped at 6:55), not to 8:20; the exit-lane extractor (since fixed) and the lane rove (since fixed) named; the commander's 9:38 north-west guess noted.

Is 'armdrag' credited with kills a disguised Dragon's Claw reported under its disguise, and does the report still name it so?
Why did the engine refuse eight cormex orders as bad sites (F2, F3, G4, F4, E2, E1)? A placement-geometry fault of that build?
Are the commander seat's wakes (first tier-2 aircraft, large losses) and the wake lines' loss counts fixed since 2026-10-04?
What did his "holy crap eco balance" (4:08) and "crap" (5:19) refer to? Nothing in our record explains them.
